subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` as a default-off operator knob for deferred background turn maintenance, or should this be tied to an existing compaction/recovery timeout policy instead?
rationale: The code appears correct, but the permanent config surface and intentional abandoned-worker fence semantics are product and compatibility choices that automation should not settle.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Knob
options.body: Land this PR as the canonical fix, preserving upgrade behavior until operators opt into a positive timeout.

options.title: Reuse Existing Timeout Policy
options.body: Revise the PR to derive maintenance timeout behavior from an existing compaction or recovery budget instead of adding a new config key.

options.title: Pause For Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Hold this branch if maintainers want burst coalescing or shorter interactive recovery policy resolved together with the timeout.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Knob
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the canonical fix, preserving upgrade behavior until operators opt into a positive timeout.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman merged the background turn-maintenance feature and is the clearest available owner signal for accepting or redirecting this config/runtime contract.
